the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Health care finances

### HSA max contribution, explained

Every year, the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) sets a contribution limit for everyone with a health
savings account (HSA). It's the maximum amount of money you can put into the account for that
calendar year.

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

###  
###  
###

and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Butterfly iQ+ and Butterfly iQ3?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible
  iPhone or Android smartphone or tablet. Both use Butterfly's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor
  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?

### Why Publish in IJERT ?

### Broad Scope

Impact of your work will have on researchers outside your field and the potential for greater
exposure.

### Indexed

Increase visibility, availability, and readership of your work on internet which attracts good
citations.

### Peer-Reviewed

All articles are evaluated using criteria including the excellence, novelty and significance of the
research or ideas.

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and
engineering by regularly publishing state-of-art peer reviewed research content in **IJERT having**
**more than 2 million articles ****downloads** per year.

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our
research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

and hosts 3000+ scholarly conferences per year in the fields of clinical, medical, pharmaceutical,

and our conferences bring together internationally renowned speakers and scientists to create
exciting and memorable events, filled with lively interactive sessions and world-class exhibitions
and poster presentations. Join us!

# Portapps

Collection of portable apps for Windows [   Apps ][8] [   Github ][9]

## What is Portapps ?

**Portapps** is a collection of [portable applications][10] for Windows. You can download your
favorite application as a portable setup or a 7z archive. Each portable app is executed through a
wrapper `[appname]-portable.exe` written in [Golang][11].

It is free and open source and always will be . All kinds of contributions are welcome ! The most
basic way to show your support is to star the project, or to raise issues You can also support this
project by [**becoming a sponsor on GitHub**][12] or by making a [Paypal donation][13] to ensure
this journey continues indefinitely!

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**
